intro.text: A Daysider and former advisor to Lord Merchant Vey.

items.text: Torkel and his family vanished in a well-known boating accident about a year earlier and were thought dead. After a raid, Ais's trackts found him alive but gravely ill in a hidden closet beside his family's bodies. He said Sharezan had locked them up because he had tried to withdraw from a secret bargain.
